title: Variable H<SUP>13</SUP>CO<SUP>+</SUP> Emission in the IM Lup Disk: X-Ray Driven Time-dependent Chemistry?
question: Does H13CO+ J=3-2 emission in the IM Lup disk vary in time relative to the continuum, and can X-ray flare driven chemistry explain it?

what.value: IM Lup disk physical model (density, temperature, UV, columns) used as chemical model input

evidence.quote: The input physical parameters are drawn from the IM Lup model presented in (cite: cleeves2016b).

what.value: Three plasma temperature components (0.3, 0.6, 2.1 keV) for IM Lup X-ray spectrum

evidence.quote: three plasma components identified in (cite: gunther2010) at 0.3, 0.6 and 2.1 keV

recipe.goal: Homogenize and image the three epochs
recipe.method: Channel-average 2014 data with cvel and image all with clean using UV taper and natural weighting to a 1.4'' circular beam

recipe.goal: Measure disk-integrated line and continuum fluxes
recipe.method: Sum spectra within the clean mask; continuum in elliptical annulus; RMS from line-free frequencies/off-source

recipe.goal: Fit Swift X-ray spectra and derive LX
recipe.method: Fit three fixed-temperature plasma components with free normalizations and absorption; integrate 1-10 keV
Evolve chemistry 0.5 Myr to steady state, then apply exponential-rise/decay flares and compute chemistry at 30 min intervals over two months at six disk points
software: Bethell & Bergin Monte Carlo X-ray radiative transfer
assumptions: No change in X-ray spectral shape during flares

recipe.goal: Estimate electron density from HCO+ decay
recipe.method: t_half = ln2/(alpha n_e) using recombination rate

answer_key.quantity: Line-to-continuum ratio increase between last two epochs

evidence.quote: Between the latter two epochs the line-to-continuum ratio increased by a factor of 2.1, or $28\sigma$.
varied between $L_{\rm X} = (9.2\pm1.8)\times10^{29}$ erg s$^{-1}$ up to $L_{\rm X} = (4.5\pm0.9)\times10^{30}$ erg s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Electron density estimate at r=50 AU, z/r=0.5

evidence.quote: $n_e$ is estimated to be $\sim2.7$ cm$^{-3}$ from these equations

not_stated_but_needed: tclean/clean parameters (cell size, image size, taper value, clean threshold, mask definition)
line-free channels and continuum subtraction details
Rest frequency and velocity range for integration
Elliptical annulus geometry for continuum flux
Swift observation IDs and exact epochs
missing_for_reproduction: Chemical code configuration and exact model inputs
score_reason: Data identified and main fluxes tabulated, but imaging/model details are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data are archival, and line and continuum fluxes are numeric, though imaging details are underspecified.
